summary: DATA-01 first read-only coverage probe. Adds a stdlib probe tool + seeds file + parser tests; resolves 8/10 owner seeds via OpenAlex, shows free-text keyword search is not a field filter, OpenAlex reference edges are largely absent for arXiv preprints, future-dated metadata needs a date ceiling, and records OpenAlex metering/arXiv 429. DATA-01 stays in_progress; no recommendation-quality claim.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 071e3db. New experiment tooling + registries/docs; read-only public metadata requests only.

budget_impact.rationale: No app runtime and no model call. The probe used the public OpenAlex works API (not a model): observed $0.001 per search, 10 credits, 1000 credits and $0.10 per day, ~11 calls (~$0.011) spent. No provider operation or ceiling changed.
budget_impact.before: No reproducible data probe; seeds only as human-readable text; arXiv assumed usable.
budget_impact.after: tools/data_probe.py + harness/seeds.json + tests; cached snapshots under .local/; documented source split (arXiv discovery, OpenAlex enrichment) and quota/rate facts.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Expected block; gates not_run and no implementation approval
Read-only probe; 8/10 seeds resolved; output in evidence file

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; tool/tests/data-source facts only, not recommendation quality

open_risks: DATA-01 incomplete: no known-relevant recall set, candidate pool still unusable by design.
arXiv coverage unverified for this field (HTTP 429 during probe).
OpenAlex reference edges largely missing; the graph feature needs another citation source.
Two seeds unresolved; titles may differ or the papers are not yet indexed.
